description: Markup.io-style client feedback tool at review.cascadeonline.dev — clients open a token link, see the live Vercel branch preview in an iframe, and pin threaded comments/change requests on elements. No accounts. Full spec: tasks/prd-review-tool.md

userStories.title: Scaffold Next.js app
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project skeleton so every later story has a place to live.
acceptanceCriteria: Next.js app (App Router, TypeScript) with output: 'standalone' in next.config
better-sqlite3 installed and building
pnpm as package manager; pnpm build and pnpm typecheck scripts work
Placeholder home page at / renders
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Next 16 (Turbopack) + React 19, TS 7. better-sqlite3 in serverExternalPackages.

userStories.title: SQLite schema and db module
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the database layer so all features have persistence.
acceptanceCriteria: Single db module opens SQLite at env DATABASE_PATH (default ./data/review.db), WAL mode, creates schema on boot if missing
projects table: id, name, slug (unique), vercel_project, vercel_team, created_at
tokens table: token (random 8+ chars, PK), project_id, branch, created_at, revoked_at nullable, last_notified_at nullable

comments table: id, token, project_id, branch, path, parent_id nullable, author, body, type ('comment'|'change_request'), status ('open'|'resolved'), selector, offset_x, offset_y, viewport_width, created_at
notified flag or notified_at column on comments (for email debounce coverage)
Tests pass (one test: insert project/token/comment and read back)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: embed.js bridge script
userStories.description: As a reviewer, my clicks inside the cross-origin iframe must reach the review shell via postMessage.
acceptanceCriteria: Served at /embed.js as a static, dependency-free script; immediately no-ops when window.self === window.top
On load, posts current path to parent; reports route changes via pushState/replaceState patch, popstate, hashchange

When parent enables comment mode, click is intercepted (default prevented): posts computed CSS selector (id, then stable data-* attribute, then structural nth-child path — never class-based), offset within element, and viewport width
Given {id, selector}[] from parent, posts each pin's current viewport coordinates; recomputes on scroll and resize, throttled
Posts list of selector ids that fail to resolve
All messages origin-checked; script ignores messages not from the review origin
Tests pass (selector generation unit-testable and tested)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Token route with iframe shell
userStories.description: As a client, I want to open /r/{token} and see the site preview so I can start reviewing.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /r/{token} looks up token; unknown or revoked token renders a 404 page
Iframe src built as https://{vercel_project}-git-{slugged-branch}-{vercel_team}.vercel.app with branch slugged per Vercel rules (e.g. feature/x -> feature-x)
First visit shows a name prompt; name stored in localStorage and reused on return visits
Desktop/mobile toggle switches iframe width between 100% and 390px
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Comments API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CRUD endpoints so the UI stories can persist feedback.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/comments creates a comment or reply (parent_id); validates token exists and is not revoked; rejects empty body/author
GET /api/comments?token=... returns all comments for the token's project+branch, threaded (roots with replies)
PATCH /api/comments/{id} toggles status open/resolved
Comments keyed to project+branch so a re-minted token on the same branch sees prior comments
Tests pass (create, thread, resolve, revoked-token rejection)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Pin creation UI
userStories.description: As a client, I want to click an element and leave a comment or change request exactly where I mean.
acceptanceCriteria: Comment-mode toggle in the shell; enabling it notifies embed.js
Click in iframe drops a pin at the reported position and opens a compose box
Compose has type chip (comment | change_request) and posts to /api/comments with anchor data, author from localStorage, current path
Escape or clicking elsewhere cancels compose without saving
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Pin rendering and threads
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want existing pins overlaid on the page and threads openable so I can read and reply.
acceptanceCriteria: Pins for the current path render overlaid at positions reported by embed.js, tracking scroll/resize
Clicking a pin opens its thread panel showing root comment and replies with author, timestamp, type chip
Reply box in thread posts with parent_id
Pins whose selector no longer resolves do not render on the page
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Sidebar, resolve, polling
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want an overview of all feedback and live-ish updates so rounds converge.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar lists all root comments across paths, grouped by path, with type and status chips; outdated (unresolvable selector) comments get an 'outdated' badge
Clicking a sidebar item navigates the iframe to that path and highlights the pin
Resolve/unresolve toggle on root comments; resolved pins hidden by default with a 'show resolved' switch
Shell polls GET /api/comments every ~5s; new comments from other viewers appear without refresh
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: SendGrid email notifications
userStories.description: As the team, I want a debounced email when clients leave feedback so nothing sits unseen.
acceptanceCriteria: On comment create: if token's last_notified_at is null or >10 min ago, send email via SendGrid v3 API (plain fetch, no SDK) to env NOTIFY_EMAIL: 'N new comments on {project}/{branch}' with the /r/{token} link, counting all unnotified comments
Comments created inside the debounce window are included in the next send — no comment is ever silently unnotified
SENDGRID_API_KEY and NOTIFY_EMAIL from env; send failure logs but never blocks comment creation
Tests pass (debounce logic with mocked send: burst of comments yields one email covering all)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Admin page
userStories.description: As the team, I want to register projects and mint token links without touching the DB by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: /admin lists projects with open/total comment counts
Add-project form: name, slug, vercel_project, vercel_team
Generate token for a project+branch; link shown with copy button; revoke button sets revoked_at
No auth code in the app (Cloudflare Access protects the path at the edge, configured at deploy time)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Containerization
userStories.description: As the team, I want the app packaged for Coolify on gpu1 so it can be deployed via the homelab playbook.
acceptanceCriteria: Dockerfile builds the Next standalone output; container runs as non-root
docker-compose.yml at repo root (not .yaml): single service, named volume mounted at the DATABASE_PATH directory, env vars DATABASE_PATH, SENDGRID_API_KEY, NOTIFY_EMAIL passed through
docker compose up serves the app locally and a created comment survives docker compose restart
README section listing the manual deploy steps from homelab-command/docs/playbook-deploy-subdomain.md (Coolify app, tunnel ingress, DNS, Access app for /admin)
Typecheck passes
